metadata.name: DesktopHost
metadata.description: The desktop shell an application runs inside: native windows, a tray icon and a quit command for a web application, with an identity (application id, product name, icon) and the local port its windows show. Reached over a private local control channel the host opens.

endpoint.description: The host's control channel: a local socket, `unix:` on Linux and macOS, `npipe:` on Windows.

token.description: The secret the application presents to the host on the control channel.

productName.description: The name a person sees: window titles, the menu bar and the installed application.

icon.description: The application icon, a PNG file of the module written `!module-path`.

port.description: The key of the root's `ports:` the windows show, a `tcp` port.

showInDock.description: `false` gives a macOS application no Dock icon and no app menu, for one that lives in the menu bar. Other platforms ignore it.

callbackPaths.description: App-relative paths an external identity provider returns to (`/auth/callback`), each starting with `/` and holding no query or fragment.
